svg.text: Inspector container scan lab: scan, export, deliver, notify
private, cyber team has read access
1 Workflow assumes a push role through OIDC, pulls two outdated images from Docker Hub, tags and pushes them to ECR
2 Inspector scans every image under inspector-lab/ continuously
3 Scheduler calls CreateFindingsReport, once for CSV and once for JSON
4 Inspector writes both reports to S3, encrypted with the lab key
5 Delivery workflow assumes a read-only role, scoped to one prefix
6 Newest CSV and JSON are downloaded
7 Files are committed under a folder named for the report date
8 Cyber team is emailed a link to the dated folder
Failure path: export or delivery failures email the cloud team
No GitHub credential in AWS. No AWS credential in GitHub. The cyber team never needs the AWS console.
